title: EDA: Energy-Efficient Inter-Layer Model Compilation for Edge DNN Inference Acceleration
problem: Inter-layer operator scheduling on edge NPUs can reduce DRAM traffic by reusing layer outputs in on-chip SRAM, but naive deep traversal of DNN operator graphs greatly increases off-chip memory transactions when on-chip SRAM is small, negating energy savings.
motivation: Edge NPUs have strict price and energy budgets where DRAM accesses dominate energy; optimizing the traversal depth of inter-layer scheduling to match available on-chip memory is critical for energy-efficient deployment of DNNs.
method: EDA is a DNN compilation framework that first transforms the DNN model into a tensor-splitting model and decomposes the model graph into subgraphs. An inter-layer cost model rapidly determines the optimal operator traversal depth for each subgraph given the available on-chip SRAM. EDA then manages the on-chip shared memory space to prevent overflow, and applies operator grouping to improve MAC unit and SRAM space utilization. The resulting compilation avoids both excessive DRAM traffic (from too-deep traversal) and under-utilization (from too-shallow traversal).
key_novelty: An inter-layer cost model that adaptively determines the optimal DNN operator traversal depth per subgraph, balancing on-chip reuse against DRAM traffic for small-SRAM edge NPUs.
contributions: EDA compilation framework with tensor-splitting and subgraph decomposition
Inter-layer cost model for fast traversal-depth determination per subgraph
On-chip shared memory management to prevent SRAM overflow during inter-layer scheduling
Operator grouping method improving MAC and SRAM utilization; 2.08x energy efficiency and 2.39x performance geomean over NPU with designated memory buffers

metrics.speedup: 2.39x geomean performance improvement over NPU with designated memory buffers

baselines: NPU with designated (fixed) memory buffers without inter-layer scheduling optimization
limitations: Not discussed; the approach targets stacked (feed-forward) DNN models and may not generalize to irregular/dynamic graph topologies.
primary_theme: adaptive inter-layer operator scheduling for edge NPU energy efficiency
